title: MC Revamped: MCR1
description: Vanilla Minecraft, but smoother, faster, and built for PvP. Perfect for Lifesteal and SMP servers.
body:
# **A DECENT PC IS REQUIRED TO PLAY**

![End Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3a6123fb1bc0ea6bb149ab1c56878aa4c076e0e3.png)

_still WIP but very playable_

Minecraft Revamped (MR1) is a Vanilla+ Fabric modpack designed to enhance the core Minecraft experience while keeping the game familiar and balanced. Instead of completely changing how Minecraft works, MR1 focuses on improving the existing systems, making gameplay smoother, more exciting, and better suited for multiplayer environments.

The modpack is especially built with PvP, exploration, and adventure in mind, making it a great fit for Lifesteal servers, SMP communities, and competitive survival worlds. Every addition aims to feel like a natural extension of vanilla Minecraft rather than a complete overhaul.

**Vanilla+ Philosophy**

MR1 follows a Vanilla+ design philosophy, meaning the goal is to enhance Minecraft rather than replace it. You will still recognize the core mechanics of the game, but many aspects are refined through small improvements, better performance, and quality-of-life upgrades.

The experience stays simple, balanced, and accessible, while still feeling fresh and modern.

**Built for Multiplayer**

Minecraft Revamped was designed with multiplayer gameplay in mind. Whether you're running a small SMP with friends or a larger community server, the modpack aims to provide a stable and enjoyable experience.

Key multiplayer focuses include:

⚔️ Improved PvP gameplay for more engaging fights

👥 Balanced survival progression that works well for servers

🧭 Exploration improvements that encourage adventure together

🛠️ Quality-of-life features that make long play sessions more enjoyable

The modpack works especially well for Lifesteal-style gameplay, where combat, strategy, and player interaction are central parts of the experience.

**Performance Focused**

MR1 is built on the Fabric mod loader, allowing the pack to stay lightweight and highly optimized. Performance is treated as a top priority, making the pack suitable for a wide range of systems while still delivering meaningful improvements.

Optimization mods help ensure:

🚀 Higher FPS and smoother gameplay

🌍 Better world loading and chunk performance

⚡ Improved server stability

🧩 Efficient mod compatibility

This makes MR1 ideal for long-term worlds, multiplayer servers, and large builds without sacrificing performance.

**Exploration & Adventure**

Adventure is a core part of Minecraft Revamped. The pack enhances exploration by making the world feel more engaging and rewarding to explore, while still keeping the classic Minecraft atmosphere intact.

Players will find themselves encouraged to:

Discover new locations

Travel further across their worlds

Engage in more player-driven adventures

Experience survival gameplay with added depth

The goal is to make every journey feel more meaningful without overwhelming the player with too many complex systems.

**Quality of Life Improvements**

MR1 includes a variety of quality-of-life enhancements designed to make everyday gameplay more convenient and enjoyable. These changes streamline many parts of Minecraft without removing the challenge that makes survival fun.

Examples include improvements to:

Inventory management

User interface and information

Building and world interaction

General gameplay convenience

These changes help reduce frustration while keeping the core survival experience intact.

**Perfect For**

Minecraft Revamped is ideal for players who want:

⚔️ Better PvP experiences

👥 Fun and stable SMP gameplay

🧭 More rewarding exploration

🚀 Optimized performance

🧩 A true Vanilla+ experience

If you enjoy Minecraft as it is but wish it felt smoother, deeper, and more polished, MR1 aims to deliver exactly that.
